name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: AI-Driven Customer Support Systems Builder
summary: Operator who builds and evaluates AI-driven support and workflow systems for a living. At Solenzo, reviews AI agent output against rubric-based grading criteria, designs self-improving evaluation loops, and expands automation coverage across the full customer lifecycle, the same core loop this kind of role is built around. Owns escalations and high-stakes account issues end to end, and brings a founder's comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and building the playbook instead of waiting for one.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Configure and evaluate AI-generated response output for client automation systems, building rubric-based grading criteria and performing the underlying data labeling to keep outputs on standard.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor agent outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.

Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel marketing-automation system — 20+ workflows — spanning lead capture/tagging/routing, lead qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture/reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Served a banking-industry client and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage in that deal.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting workflow design and resolving technical challenges during setup.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
